description: This file defines the search layout configurations ('searchdefs') for the 'Accounts' module in a SuiteCRM (SugarCRM fork) project. It specifies the layout metadata for basic and advanced search forms, including fields, labels, types, options, and conditional inclusion of an opt-in flag. It also performs a security check to prevent direct access.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: A class used to access configuration settings within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: isConfirmOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the Confirm Opt-In feature is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: isOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the Opt-In feature is enabled in the configuration.
